blocks.text:
Rio is best seen from two heights. The cable car to Sugar Loaf goes via Urca. From the top, you can see Copacabana, Ipanema, Guanabara Bay, the bridge to Niterói and Corcovado.

The next day, a train climbs through the forest to the statue of Christ the Redeemer. At 710 m, views open up over the city, the Botanical Garden, Maracanã, the bay and the ocean coast.

blocks.text: The Brazilian side offers a sweeping panorama of the cascades. On the Argentine side, boardwalks lead to the upper and lower circuits and Devil's Throat. These are two different ways to experience the same natural wonder: first appreciate its scale from a distance, then get almost within touching distance of the water.
